tools.name: fitlab_catalog_describe
tools.description: Official description/ship skill bonuses and base attributes by name OR typeId. Exact name auto-resolves; ambiguity returns candidates.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_search
tools.description: Filter/sort explicit base attributes in native units. Follow next action for more. Missing filter values are excluded and counted.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_resolve
tools.description: Resolve multiple names without guessing ambiguous matches.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_attributes
tools.description: Discover official attribute IDs/names/units before filtering.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_compare
tools.description: Compare the same named base attributes across items in one call.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_variants
tools.description: Official variation family, not guessed replacements.

tools.name: fitlab_catalog_charges
tools.description: Discover declared ammunition/script groups; preview verifies the actual pair.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_roster
tools.description: Read actual drones/fighters/subsystems/implants/boosters and authoritative fitted bay/primary-output projections. setFighters/setDrones etc replace the whole named collection.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_list
tools.description: Find durable fitting sessions and their revisions; working/saved metadata remain distinct. Changed library invalidates cursor.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_create
tools.description: Create durable fit; default skills untrained, optional all5. Returns calculated summary/revision.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_read
tools.description: Calculated fitted totals, modules and readiness.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_edit
tools.description: Atomic changes at revision with stable requestId. install.item includes slotIndex, chargeTypeId and active. Passive modules use active:false. No automatic save.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_preview
tools.description: Evaluate the same changes without committing. Returns deltas and diagnostics.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_attributes
tools.description: Named fitted values for ship or module.<instanceId>/charge.<instanceId>.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_outputs
tools.description: Paged compact output IDs, per-metric values/states and native scoped totals. Follow next; pages bind fitHash. Full traces remain by reference.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_curves
tools.description: Engine DPS curves: default online ship weapons or explicit contributionIds. Explicit target geometry or declared ideal reference. No combat or sustained-output claim.

tools.name: fitlab_fitting_save
tools.description: Explicitly save the draft at revision.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_policies
tools.description: Discover preset coverage and optionally check a prepared draft without changing fitting or starting a battle.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_prepare
tools.description: Validate immutable fitting revisions, conditions and finite ammo; returns draftId and capability limits. Does not start.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_run
tools.description: Prepare and start an experiment in one call with stable jobId, then bounded wait. Reuse identical input after uncertain outcome. Conditions are retained with the job.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_start
tools.description: Start the prepared draft once; default stationary weapons only. No movement/repair/EWAR/drone policy implied.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_wait
tools.description: Wait up to 60 seconds; returns final report or actionable pending state. Failure is not combat defeat.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_report
tools.description: Experiment-bound result: destruction time, last-damage snapshot, end snapshot and damage application are distinct. expectedDraftId rejects cross-experiment substitution.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_events
tools.description: Filtered authoritative events; next preserves filters and cursor.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_cancel
tools.description: Cooperative cancellation; partial checkpoint is not completed battle.

tools.name: fitlab_battle_resume
tools.description: Resume only a compatible resumable checkpoint at expected revision. Keeps attempt identity.

tools.name: fitlab_jobs_list
tools.description: Discover job IDs/states/bytes and storage, including old results.

tools.name: fitlab_jobs_storage
tools.description: Quota, remaining bytes and next actions.

tools.name: fitlab_jobs_compact
tools.description: dryRun defaults true. Reclaim redundant recovery only for an inactive job at revision; final results and identities are retained. Apply only when cleanup is requested.

tools.name: fitlab_help_overview
tools.description: Task routes and runnable examples, from ship traits to weapons/curves and combat research.

tools.name: fitlab_help_operation
tools.description: Exact operation schema and example route.

tools.name: fitlab_help_native
tools.description: Advanced native tool discovery. Omit name to list. Ordinary tasks use catalog/fitting/battle/jobs.

tools.name: fitlab_status_read
tools.description: Version/source/coverage and storage health. No browser required.

tools.name: fitlab_raw_call
tools.description: Advanced native escape hatch; arguments follow help.native schema, with native side-effect semantics.

tools.name: fitlab_result_read
tools.description: Page a full detail reference; ordinary results are already task-shaped.
